prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is not named on the policy and does not live with the policyholder.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy street in Pasadena, Texas, when the car behind me hit my rear bumper hard enough to throw my head forward and then back against the headrest. My neck snapped, the windshield seemed to flash white, and for a few seconds I could not think clearly. Later I was diagnosed with a concussion, and I have had headaches, dizziness, and trouble concentrating since then. I have described what happened the same way to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff, and I have nothing to add or change. I should also state that I am not listed on the policy and I do not live with the policyholder. I was driving the vehicle with permission, and I am making this claim based on my own injuries and what I saw and felt at the time.
